evidence: Visual bounds traced from the extracted ROM scene-1 composite (mode-1.bmp) and its priority overlay. Mike's RPG Center Puyallup marker 5 identifies this as Underground 93; ROM contract-location index 4 independently uses that name. ROM scene-1 event record 70 at 0x17D9C0 selects field scene 15; event 4 has no nuyen/reputation admission branch. FFFC1E bit 29 is HEART_DELIVERED and gates only the post-load Scene-15 world actor list (script index 5, kind-3 actor) unless a compact runner marker is 10. The interaction rectangles remain separate from the facade and concrete forecourt. The guide's 100-nuyen/6-Reputation note is not expressed by this ROM route.
